value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym Sundays 9:30-10:15, Sept 14 to Oct 26, $124 (plus $25 membership) for walking to 3.5 years with a parent - their site says, and fall registration has been open since July 22 until classes fill. They also have Kinderfun (3-5, drop off) Saturdays 10:30. Want me to check a spot is left?
